# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"an unobtainable block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} was an unobtainable block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.0.2"}} and removed in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It was the first block implemented in {{"of":"to_base:mod / to_base:to_sky_and_stars"}} for testing purposes, but was removed in {{"of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0","short":true}}, as it served no purpose that wasn't fulfilled by {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_base:test_block"}}.

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} has the same blue texture present on each side of the block.
